evidence.title: QDistRnd: A GAP package for computing the distance of quantum error-correcting codes
evidence.supports: A published public implementation exists for repeated quantum-code distance calculations.

evidence.title: Distance-Finding Algorithms for Quantum Codes and Circuits
evidence.supports: Distance finding remains an active algorithmic task with explicit computational methods.

evidence.title: qLDPC public software repository
evidence.supports: QDistRnd is integrated into a public quantum-code software ecosystem.

evidence.title: Google Cloud general-purpose machine pricing
evidence.supports: The listed c3-standard-8 price supplies a mutable public compute-cost anchor, not a measured Prob-000 saving.

assumptions.label: Social discount rate
assumptions.rationale: Worked-example choice aligned with the UK Green Book headline social time preference rate.

assumptions.label: Full-success probability
assumptions.rationale: Scenario probability for a result that supports the full modeled benefit path.

assumptions.label: Full-success adopting teams
assumptions.rationale: Scenario adoption count; no external source establishes future Prob-000 adoption.

assumptions.label: Full-success runs per team per year
assumptions.rationale: Scenario workload for repeated distance calculations.

assumptions.label: Full-success benefit years
assumptions.rationale: Five-year scenario horizon with end-of-year benefits.

assumptions.label: Full-success compute time avoided
assumptions.rationale: Scenario runtime reduction applied to the public price anchor.

assumptions.label: Full-success researcher time released
assumptions.rationale: Scenario time release before applying the productive recapture fraction.

assumptions.label: Partial-success probability
assumptions.rationale: Scenario probability for a narrower but useful result.

assumptions.label: Partial-success adopting teams
assumptions.rationale: Lower scenario adoption than the full-success branch.

assumptions.label: Partial-success runs per team per year
assumptions.rationale: Lower scenario workload than the full-success branch.

assumptions.label: Partial-success benefit years
assumptions.rationale: Three-year scenario horizon with end-of-year benefits.

assumptions.label: Loaded researcher-hour social value
assumptions.rationale: Scenario conversion value, not a measured wage or market price for all users.

assumptions.label: Productive time recapture fraction
assumptions.rationale: Only one fifth of released researcher time is assumed to become additional productive work.

assumptions.label: Decision-useful negative-result probability
assumptions.rationale: Scenario probability for learning that prevents futile follow-up.

assumptions.label: Avoided futile follow-up value
assumptions.rationale: Scenario decision value of a technically negative result.

assumptions.label: Without-research counterfactual value
assumptions.rationale: Benefits expected without the proposed research and therefore not attributable to it.

assumptions.label: Research cost
assumptions.rationale: Scenario present value of the resources required to perform the research.
